text: A full input-cost worksheet for a 1,000 m² drip-irrigated cucumber plot is provided, covering: drip irrigation mainline and fittings, trellis stakes/net, plastic mulch, seed, fertilizers (N-P-K, urea, MAP, KCl, calcium nitrate, magnesium sulfate), pesticides and sprayer, fuel/water pump, and miscellaneous costs — totaling roughly 2,566,000 riel per 1,000 m² in the worked example. Average yield in the same example is about 4.4 tons per 1,000 m² at an assumed 1,000 riel/kg, giving revenue of about 4,400,000 riel and net profit of about 1,834,000 riel per 1,000 m² per cycle.
caveat: These are the example figures from the 2019 STEER manual's worked cost table for Kaoh Kong province; actual costs and farm-gate prices will vary by year, location and market conditions and should not be quoted to a farmer as current pricing.
